title: Target-Aware Curation of Hallucination Stress Tests for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hallucination stress tests can yield similar average scores across language models even when different prompts elicit hallucinations in each model. We develop a procedure that iteratively edits source-grounded seed prompts to expose hallucinations in a target model. An LLM editor revises each prompt in response to the target's answer and a judge's category-specific score and explanation. In the main setting, the target also receives feedback on its previous response. Experiments cover 500 seeds from seven datasets and ten topics, with intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations evaluated across open-weight and closed-source models. Editing substantially increases judge-rated severity over the seeds. In the baseline configuration, retained responses fall in the judge's strong-hallucination bin in 77.2% of runs targeting extrinsic hallucination and 74.2% targeting intrinsic hallucination. translated_title: 面向目标模型的大语言模型幻觉压力测试精准筛选方法
translated_abstract: 幻觉压力测试即使在不同提示会引发不同模型产生幻觉的情况下，也可能在各语言模型间产生相似的平均分数。我们开发了一种流程，通过迭代编辑基于来源的种子提示来暴露目标模型中的幻觉。一个LLM编辑器根据目标模型的回答以及评判者给出的特定类别分数和解释来修订每个提示。在主要设置中，目标模型还会收到关于其先前回答的反馈。实验涵盖来自七个数据集和十个主题的500个种子，在开放权重和闭源模型上评估了内在和外在幻觉。编辑显著提高了评判者评定的幻觉严重程度，超过了种子提示的水平。在基线配置中，针对外在幻觉的运行中有77.2%、针对内在幻觉的运行中有74.2%的保留回答落入评判者的强幻觉区间。后续编辑轮次贡献了超过一半的效果。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种目标感知的迭代提示编辑方法，利用LLM编辑器根据目标模型的回答和评判者反馈不断修改种子提示，从而精准暴露特定模型的幻觉弱点，即使各模型在标准压力测试中平均分数相似也能区分出差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a target-aware iterative prompt editing procedure, where an LLM editor revises source-grounded seed prompts based on the target model's responses and judge feedback, enabling precise exposure of hallucination weaknesses in specific models even when their average stress test scores appear similar.
